route: fixed-work benchmark (--branch-clock, fixed --max-batches) over 22 apps; StarCraft is the candidate of record, the rest are in box/res
command: node box/scripts/sweep.js --apps=... --arms=m,off,off2,all[,lX,pLazy,def,dA..dZE,u0xMASK] --reps=N (perf stat -e instructions:u,cycles:u,branch-misses:u -- taskset -c 1-3 node test/run.js --no-build --branch-clock ...)

environment.boat: box-node x2 (bx_b86yx6bp, bx_5jze62f9, now deleted), Node 24.22.1, perf 6.8.12, taskset 1-3
environment.hetzner: fast-near-3tb-1 i9-13900, CPUs 0/2/4/6, Node 24 at ~/wa-bench/node, no perf

summary: Trusted metric: boat instructions:u (null band 0-0.47%) and Hetzner user CPU (0.4-0.8% on 112 s runs). Every arm is exact on 21/22 apps; gta2 runs without branch-clock. The full stack does LESS work than main only on spelunky_classic (-7.2%), spelunky_classic_hd (-1.8%) and lifegen. On 14 apps it does 1.0-3.1% MORE work than main: this is a module tax from merged code in $uop_fast/$uop_rg_grow that is present with every opt off. Lazy re-guard: -9/-12% on castle/RA, +4.25% on SC. uop-opt 0xffff: +1.7-2.1% on H3 (bits 0x40/0x200/0x800). Ladder bit 8 is inert. Moorhuhn 3: 20/20 pass, no bug. Decomposition caveat: the spel30 gameplay window is ~82% GM8 frame-pacing spin.

findings.app: 14 of 22 (castle, h2, h3, caesar, simcity, RA, SC, diablo, mw3, hexen2, jazz2, pinball, metro, gta2)
findings.mechanism: module tax: with every opt off the branch runs 0.2-4.4% more instructions than main, with identical uop ledgers. perf on RA: $uop_fast +1.5% and $uop_rg_grow +1.0% of total samples. V8 arm64 $uop_fast 2358->4190 insns, stack refs 123->235
findings.recommendation: fix before merge: move uop-opt/SSE-native/svc paths out of $uop_fast into cold helpers; split the cost between the dfde and gm-fold2 merges

findings.mechanism: generic path spends 6.3% of samples in $phys80_materialize/$phys80_invalidate

findings.delta: -7.22% ins vs main; spel30 G -28.3% whole / -54.3% gameplay CPU vs all-off
findings.mechanism: Delphi + GM folds; the base tier's gameplay gain drops to -0.3% once the folds are on

findings.delta: -12.6% ins on uop; -13.5% full stack vs all-off

findings.mechanism: lazy re-guard costs more than it saves

findings.recommendation: per-app opt-in in lib/apps.js, or an adaptive policy
keep default 0; drop those bits for x87-heavy apps

findings.mechanism: no single bit; GM fold 0 hits

startupMemory: startUser (first fifth of the run) all vs main is within that metric's 10-26% spread on every app, so not resolvable. RSS is within 2% on 18 apps; H3/Caesar/RA/rattler are bimodal, and uop-opt may add 40-90 MB on H3 (unresolved). wasm +20.6 KB (+0.8%). Whole-module native code: TurboFan +0.7%, Ion +0.7%. x86-64 native disassembly is missing (arm64 only).
caveats: In the spel30 gameplay window, ~82% of threaded instructions are GM8's frame-pacing wait (0x49a64c, per spel-browser). The decomposition is equal-work CPU but mostly measures the spin. Browser cross-check: folds 25-27 steps/s vs 11 without the Delphi fold.
The off arm includes --no-fpu-direct, so 'main vs off' mixes the fpu-direct cost (H3, moorhuhn) with the module tax; 'all vs main' is the clean comparison.
Boat cycles:u and user CPU are not trusted (5-70% spread).
